Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Null Pulse (EC09)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Resolve vs Composure

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature cannot use Reactions until the start of your next Turn. This does not cancel a Reaction already declared or stop Actions on its own Turn.

Surge 1: Deal 1 Psychic Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Surge 2: Reduce each successfully affected creature’s Composure by 1 for the same duration. Once per use.

Design note: No persuasion, loyalty change, interrogation effect, or out-of-Combat behavioral compulsion.
system.flavor: Opening a brief interval in which enemies cannot react.
